freetrade.guide.header: Live settings of this server · database: %s
freetrade.guide.page.1.body:
The Trade Association buys and sells goods for U.M. (units of money).
Money on this server: %1$s.
Pay with money items and the change comes back in money items, largest first.
Lightman's Currency bank account: %2$s.
freetrade.guide.page.1.title: The Trade Association
freetrade.guide.page.2.body:
Price of one unit on this server = %1$s
(x = stock now, b = base value, r = reference stock; default r here = %2$s).
Price ceiling: %3$s. Minimum price of one unit: %4$s U.M.
Each trade moves the price a little (slippage).
Prices are always whole U.M.: the real total of the trade is computed first and then rounded (.5 or more rounds up, less rounds down).
Items worth less than 1 U.M. are traded only in lots: if a stick is worth 0.5 U.M., sticks are traded 2 at a time.
Abusing the rounding (trading one by one to gain from it) raises your backoff for that item.
freetrade.guide.page.2.title: Prices and supply
freetrade.guide.page.3.body:
Items nobody declared get a value from the cheapest recipe that makes them, plus %1$s labor per crafting step.
Prices follow the ingredients' current prices: %2$s.
When they do, selling lots of logs lowers their price, and the planks and sticks made from them get cheaper too.
freetrade.guide.page.3.title: Values from recipes
freetrade.guide.page.4.body:
Give an unemployed villager an Auto Buyer as its workstation to make a Trade Representative.
Right-click it to open the trade window.
Sell one item type at a time, up to %1$s stacks; only whole lots are taken and the payout comes back as money.
Damaged tools and armor: %2$s.
To buy, pick an item in the catalog and choose the amount.
freetrade.guide.page.4.title: The Trade Representative
freetrade.guide.page.5.body:
Set a ghost item to choose what it sells; drag one in from JEI or EMI.
While it gets a redstone signal it sells up to %1$s items every %2$s s, in whole lots.
Adjacent chests and barrels multiply its capacity, up to 6x.
The money selector picks the money item for withdrawals. Hoppers take money out only with redstone.
freetrade.guide.page.5.title: Sell Point
freetrade.guide.page.6.body:
Put money in and it buys the item it is set to, up to %1$s items every %2$s s, at the catalog price.
Hoppers take the bought items out only with a redstone signal.
freetrade.guide.page.6.title: Auto Buyer
freetrade.guide.page.7.body:
Tax on this server: %1$s on sales, %2$s on purchases. The tax goes to the server's OP account.
Backoff: %3$s.
Treasury: %4$s. It pays for what players sell to the association, and what players buy refills it; an empty finite treasury stops the association from buying from players.
freetrade.guide.page.7.title: Taxes, backoff and treasury
